title: Count in Range
difficulty: Medium
position: 9
complexity: O((n + q) log n)
=== statement
You are given `n` numbers and `q` questions. Each question gives a range `a b` and asks how many of the numbers are at least `a` and at most `b`.
=== input
The first line has `n` and `q`. The second line has the `n` numbers. Each of the next `q` lines has a question `a b`.
=== output
Print `q` lines: the answer to each question, in order.
=== constraints
1 <= n <= 131072
1 <= q <= 65536
0 <= numbers <= 10^6
0 <= a <= b <= 10^6
=== sample
5 3
4 1 3 1 5
2 4
1 1
6 9
--- expected
2
2
0
